fact: The Judiciary of Malawi's concept note says the e-court, which incorporates digitisation of court proceedings and documentation with electronic filing and online portals, is in a pilot phase linking ten courts, six prisons and four police stations.
The Judiciary of Malawi's concept note says digital case management platforms "have already been introduced" as part of the e-court's digitisation of court proceedings.
